Total reflections supply, reduced by _reflectFee on every taxable transfer.

Blacklist map toggled by setBots/delBot and enforced in _transfer.
Maximum transaction amount enforced when buying from the pair.
ERC20 allowance table written by _approve.
Stored Uniswap pair address used in _transfer branch conditions.
Uniswap V2 router instance set in openTrading and used for swaps/liquidity.
Recipient of half the swapped ETH and privileged caller of manualswap/manualsend.
Second fee recipient receiving half the swapped ETH.
Reentrancy guard flag set by lockTheSwap and checked in _transfer.
Enables automatic contract-balance swapping inside _transfer.
Private core transfer: sets fees, enforces cooldown/bots/maxTx, triggers swap and ETH send.
Swaps contract tokens for ETH via router under lockTheSwap guard.
Splits ETH balance and pushes it to the two fee wallets.

Wallet1-only manual swap of the full contract token balance.
Wallet1-only manual push of contract ETH to fee wallets.
Owner-only loop adding addresses to the bot blacklist.
Owner-only removal of an address from the bot blacklist.
Applies reflection balance math, takes team fee and reflects fee.
Mints reflection share of the team fee to the contract address.
Reduces _rTotal and increases _tFeeTotal; arithmetic on reflection supply.
Computes t/r transfer, fee and team values from the amount and rate.

Caller address used for transfers, approvals and privilege checks.

Transaction origin, not actually used for authorization in this contract.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the from address in transfer/_transfer, so the caller directly controls the transfer origin.
block.timestamp is written into the cooldown mapping, making the buy gate timestamp dependent.
_transfer reads and writes cooldown[to] against block.timestamp to gate purchases.
uniswapV2Pair is compared against from/to to select the fee and swap branch.
swapEnabled gates whether the contract swaps its token balance during a transfer.
inSwap is checked to avoid re-entering the swap logic.
_isExcludedFromFee lookups decide fee application and swap eligibility.
bots[from] and bots[to] are required to be false, so the blacklist controls whether transfers succeed.
_maxTxAmount bounds the amount accepted when buying from the pair.
The to parameter is used throughout the fee/cooldown/branch logic of _transfer.
The from parameter drives the pair/exclusion checks in _transfer.
The amount parameter is validated and then passed into _tokenTransfer.
contractTokenBalance is read from balanceOf and used to size the swap.
contractETHBalance is read from the contract balance and used to trigger sendETHToFee.
The amount parameter of sendETHToFee is halved and transferred to both wallets.
tokenAmount is approved and passed to the router swap call.
_transfer calls swapTokensForEth when the swap conditions are met.
_transfer calls sendETHToFee with the contract ETH balance.
swapTokensForEth performs an external router swap while the state-changing transfer flow is still executing.
lockTheSwap sets and clears the inSwap flag around the router swap.
swapTokensForEth approves the router through _approve, writing _allowances.
sendETHToFee pushes ETH to external wallets through payable transfers during transfer execution.
_transfer delegates the actual balance mutation to _transferStandard via _tokenTransfer.
_transfer calls _tokenTransfer at the end of its execution.
_tokenTransfer calls _transferStandard to apply reflection math.
_transferStandard calls _getValues to compute transfer/fee/team amounts.
_transferStandard takes the team fee through _takeTeam.
_transferStandard reflects the fee through _reflectFee.
_rOwned[sender] and _rOwned[recipient] are read and rewritten with sub/add in _transferStandard.
_takeTeam adds the reflection team amount to _rOwned[address(this)].
_reflectFee subtracts the reflection fee from _rTotal.
manualswap authorizes by comparing _msgSender() with _feeAddrWallet1.
_feeAddrWallet1 is the privileged caller identity checked in manualswap.
manualswap invokes swapTokensForEth on the full contract balance.
manualsend authorizes by comparing _msgSender() with _feeAddrWallet1.
_feeAddrWallet1 is the privileged caller identity checked in manualsend.
manualsend calls sendETHToFee with the contract ETH balance.
openTrading assigns the router instance that will be trusted for later swaps.
openTrading creates and stores the uniswapV2Pair address.
openTrading sends ETH into addLiquidityETH, an external payable call using the whole contract balance.
openTrading enables swapEnabled as part of trading activation.
openTrading lowers _maxTxAmount to the post-launch limit.
openTrading approves the contract and the pair through _approve, writing _allowances.
setBots is gated by onlyOwner which compares _msgSender() with _owner.
The bots_ array parameter is iterated to write the blacklist.
setBots writes true into the bots blacklist that gates transfers.
delBot is gated by onlyOwner which compares _msgSender() with _owner.
The notbot parameter selects the blacklist entry to clear.
delBot writes false into the bots blacklist that gates transfers.
The router swap interacts with the pair and can invoke token transfer hooks back into the _transfer flow.
Pushing ETH to fee wallets can re-enter the contract through receive() while state is mid-update.
tx.origin is externally controllable but no authorization in the transfer path relies on it, documenting the taint.

normalization_plan.reason: The from parameter only feeds the _transfer branch conditions and balance updates.
The to parameter only feeds the _transfer branch conditions and balance updates.
The amount parameter is validated and consumed entirely inside _transfer.
The cached token balance is a transient local used only to size the swap call.
The cached ETH balance is a transient local used only to trigger the fee send.
The amount parameter is halved and transferred within sendETHToFee only.
The tokenAmount parameter is approved and swapped inside swapTokensForEth only.
The notbot parameter is used solely to clear one blacklist entry in delBot.
The bots_ array is iterated only to populate the blacklist in setBots.
